name: Puzzle Lock Chain
description: The dependency graph a room actually is. A lock opens when its declared conditions are met, and conditions may name other locks — which is what turns five puzzles into an escape room rather than five puzzles. Because it is a graph, it can be asked what is currently solvable, and that single query is the difference between a player who is stuck and a player who is lost: a nudge system, a journal and a difficulty curve all read the same frontier. The chain refuses to load a configuration containing a cycle, since a room where A needs B and B needs A cannot be completed and should fail at author time rather than at play time.

inputs.name: locks
inputs.description: Locks with their opening conditions, which may reference other locks. Required.

inputs.name: rejectCycles
inputs.description: Whether a circular dependency is refused on load. A cycle is an unwinnable room.

inputs.name: announceFrontier
inputs.description: Whether the set of currently-solvable locks is published, so nudges and journals read the same source.

outputs.name: frontier
outputs.description: Locks whose conditions are reachable now.

outputs.name: blockedBy
outputs.description: Per closed lock, the conditions still outstanding.
